steps.label: Check anatomy rules
steps.detail: 44 of 130 rules mapped; 26 run now, 18 after planning; 4 warnings, 3 notes; 86 unmapped

reading.notes: Adult male with prominent brown mane walking toward camera in dry savanna grassland.
Large brown mottled octopus with eight outstretched arms resting on sandy gravel seabed underwater, mantle and eyes clearly visible.

spec.rationale: Quadruped amphibious design uses the lion torso, legs and head to walk on land as the primary medium and to swim secondarily in shallow water with grasping by the octopus-derived sucker tail, resolving the quadruped versus multi-legged conflict. Habitat conflict flagged with no shared habitat between lion grassland and octopus marine, requiring a marine to land habitat-change note for the tail.
spec.name: Maned Reef Prowler

warnings.message: A fusion may not assign two different coverings to the same body region without naming the region for each.
A fusion's habitat list must overlap at least one habitat of each parent, or the non-overlap must be flagged as a habitat conflict.
warnings.detail: no shared habitat: lion forest/grassland/mountain; common octopus marine

warnings.message: A marine-only fusion must not be built from a terrestrial-only parent without a habitat-change note.
warnings.detail: common octopus lives only in the sea; lion only on land

warnings.message: A fusion with a body_plan conflict (e.g. finned x quadruped with no amphibious design note) must be flagged, not silently resolved by picking one parent's plan.
A fusion with no habitat overlap with a parent must be flagged as a habitat conflict in the test output.
warnings.detail: no shared habitat: lion forest/grassland/mountain; common octopus marine

warnings.message: A fusion that walks and swims must state whether it walks on land and swims in water, or whether one medium is primary.

A parent with active_time 'unrecorded' adds no tokens. The fusion's active_time is built from the other parents' values under R-A4-05, R-A4-06 and R-A4-P03. If every parent is 'unrecorded', the fusion's active_time is 'unrecorded' and the app shows it as 'activity pattern unknown'. 'unrecorded' never blocks a fusion and is never combined with other tokens.
warnings.detail: active time unrecorded for common octopus: it adds nothing and does not block the fusion

spec.prompt:
Reference image 1 shows a lion. Use it only for the head, torso, limbs and skin covering.
Reference image 2 shows a common octopus. Use it only for the tail.
Create one new creature with a single, committed quadruped body plan.
Place the lion's head, torso, limbs and skin covering on the common octopus's frame so every join heals naturally: no visible seams, no floating parts, no duplicated limbs.

Show the full body in a calm three-quarter view on a plain, softly lit background, in the style of a natural history field-guide plate. Photographic realism, accurate anatomy, no text, no labels, no people.
